description: This file defines the Cache class within the OpenCart framework, providing methods to interact with cache storage through an adaptor pattern. It includes constructor, get, set, and delete methods for cache management.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: Provides cache management functions including get, set, and delete, utilizing dynamic adaptor classes based on specified type.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache with a specified adaptor type and optional expiration; throws exception if the adaptor class does not exist.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache item by key through the adaptor.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a cache item with a key, value, and optional expiration time.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cache item identified by key.
